description: This file is a Python script for a sales order analysis report in the ERPNext system. It includes functions for filtering, data retrieval, and chart preparation related to sales orders, with specific focus on sales order status, delivery delays, and billing amounts.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the sales order analysis report, returning columns, data, and chart data based on filters.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates the provided filters for the report, ensuring date ranges are correct.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on the filters provided.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves sales order data from the database based on conditions and filters.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Processes raw data for report display and chart visualization, including grouping and summing.

methods.name: prepare_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for the donut chart visualization showing pending and completed amounts.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report table based on filters.
